roles.name: Grilling Facilitator
roles.responsibility: Forms shared understanding before formal system architecture begins: investigates derivable facts before asking the user, asks one question at a time and follows the most important unresolved branch, uses the System Design Brief topics as coverage rather than a questionnaire, and owns working Brief synthesis and Brief Change Request facilitation. Never makes formal architecture decisions, closes Findings, or advances workflow state.

writePermissions.target: ignored run-workspace working Brief, Brief Change Request and decision artifacts

prohibited: making formal architecture decisions
converting an investigable fact into a user decision
freezing a Brief without explicit whole-Brief user confirmation
modifying a frozen Brief in place
closing review Findings
advancing workflow state or choosing successors beyond the declared set

roles.name: Evidence Scout
roles.responsibility: Resolves one derivable factual gap without restarting Intake/Grilling or asking the user; returns only to the recorded requester (SD-05 direction review or the affected SD-09 review lens) before aggregation resumes.

prohibited: changing the recorded resume_action or resume_lens
asking the user for derivable facts
making design decisions
writing the Brief, Skeleton or Draft
choosing a successor outside the recorded requester

roles.name: System Designer
roles.responsibility: Single writer for the System Design: produces the Skeleton, expands and integrates the Draft, consumes validated Revision Requests, prepares design-owned Spike requests, applies valid Spike results, and classifies downstream handoffs. Runs in a session that does not inherit hidden grilling context.

writePermissions.target: ignored run-workspace Skeleton, Draft checkpoints, integrated Draft and revision artifacts

prohibited: mutating the frozen Brief
closing its own Findings
promoting artifacts to repository paths
making human decisions
executing Spikes inside a Skill

roles.name: Architecture Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Challenges the Skeleton before expensive expansion and runs the architecture lens of the final review; fresh read-only sessions; suspicious smells become Findings only after project-specific impact is evidenced.

writePermissions.target: review finding artifacts and REVIEW_SIGNAL records

prohibited: writing the Brief, Skeleton or Draft
admitting a Finding without project-specific impact evidence
seeing another lens analysis before the review barrier closes
voting on design decisions

roles.name: Problem-Solution Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Runs the problem-solution lens of the final review: Brief/scenario/scope-to-design traceability; fresh read-only sessions; findings require project-specific impact evidence.

writePermissions.target: review finding artifacts and REVIEW_SIGNAL records

prohibited: writing the Brief, Skeleton or Draft
admitting a Finding without project-specific impact evidence
seeing another lens analysis before the review barrier closes
voting on design decisions

roles.name: Quality & Acceptance Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Runs the quality and acceptance lens of the final review: contextual NFR, under/over-design, risk, thresholds, Spikes and evidence; fresh read-only sessions; findings require project-specific impact evidence.

writePermissions.target: review finding artifacts and REVIEW_SIGNAL records

prohibited: writing the Brief, Skeleton or Draft
admitting a Finding without project-specific impact evidence
seeing another lens analysis before the review barrier closes
voting on design decisions

roles.name: Finding Aggregator
roles.responsibility: Aggregates and triages Findings behind the review barrier: merges corroborating Findings while preserving provenance, relates common causes, identifies contradictions, and routes by evidence and affected stage. Holds no technical decision authority.

prohibited: deciding by majority
hiding risk
inflating signals
changing severity without returning to the source Reviewer
closing Findings

roles.name: Fresh Reader
roles.responsibility: Reads the candidate Design in a context-isolated session and tests whether a downstream implementer can understand problem, decomposition, flows, ownership, constraints, quality mechanisms, parameter status and acceptance; finds ambiguity and hidden assumptions but does not reopen architecture based on preference.

writePermissions.target: fresh reader question set and finding artifacts

prohibited: receiving grilling transcripts or hidden author/reviewer context
reopening architecture based on preference
writing the Design
closing architecture Findings

roles.name: Runtime Custodian
roles.responsibility: Declarative route-closure role for the Runtime's deterministic lifecycle authority (SD-14 final verification and SD-15 freeze/promote/clean). Not an Agent Role: no Agent session, no Skill, no design judgment; executes only the declared deterministic validators and lifecycle rules.

writePermissions.target: repository deliverable (final Design and explicitly requested formal companions) via approved manifest

prohibited: judging architecture quality or project appropriateness
relaxing a Gate
promoting intermediate artifacts
creating docs/**/workflow-artifacts/ paths or tracking run-workspace artifacts in Git
reporting IMPLEMENTATION_READY while verification or cleanup fails
